usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.chat.completions.delete("completion_id")
pp result

fields.name: object
fields.description: The type of object being deleted.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The ID of the chat completion that was deleted.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the chat completion was deleted.
